name: @truefrontier/claude-dev-workflow
description: An automated software development pipeline that uses Claude AI to guide issues through structured development stages with human oversight.
author: True Frontier

scripts.setup:labels: node -e "const os = require('os'); const { execSync } = require('child_process'); const script = os.platform() === 'win32' ? 'scripts/setup-labels.bat' : './scripts/setup-labels.sh'; try { execSync(script, { stdio: 'inherit' }); } catch (error) { console.error('Setup failed:', error.message); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.docs:labels:
node -e "console.log('
Workflow Labels:
=============

🔵 needs:* (AI working):
- needs:specify, needs:specify-revision
- needs:plan, needs:plan-revision
- needs:develop, needs:develop-revision

🟢 review:* (human review):
- review:specify, review:plan, review:develop

🔴 error:* (needs help):
- error:specify, error:plan, error:develop

Usage: Only one workflow label should be active per issue at a time
');"
scripts.postinstall:
echo '
🚀 Claude Dev Workflow installed!

Next steps:
1. Run: npx @truefrontier/claude-dev-workflow help
2. Initialize: npx @truefrontier/claude-dev-workflow init
'
